newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to off 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to off 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to off 0.05 cent Monday, dealers said.
Activity is expected to remain rangebound through the May delivery period, they added, with support seen at the recent low of 10.91 cents a lb and resistance at 11.20 cents for July delivery.

Prices closed firmer and near session highs Friday as the funds covered short positions. Most-active July closed up 0.07 cent at 11.15 cents agfter trading from 11.15 to 10.98 cents. Spot May closed up 0.09 at 11.55 cents.
The last trading day for the May contract is April 30.
LIFFE white sugar futures were weaker amid origin selling on Monday. At 0845 EST/1345 GMT, August stood down 70 cents to $314.20, while the back months were $1.10 to $0.10 lower.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
